name: Back Up n8n Workflows to GitLab

n_406bd90743c8b6e3.name: Configure the backup
n_406bd90743c8b6e3.source: export default function config({owner,project,path,tag}){for(const [k,v]of Object.entries({owner,project,path,tag}))if(typeof v!=='string'||!v.trim()||v.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure '+k);if(owner.split('/').some(x=>!x||x==='.'||x==='..'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/.test(x))||project==='.'||project==='..'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/.test(project)||path.startsWith('/')||path.endsWith('/')||path.split('/').some(x=>!x||x==='.'||x==='..')||tag.split(',').some(x=>!x.trim()))throw Error('Invalid repository configuration');const p='/projects/'+encodeURIComponent(owner+'/'+project);return{owner,project,path,tag:tag.split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).join(','),projectEndpoint:p,branchEndpoint:p+'/repository/branches/main'}}

n_e4465b52431cc920.name: Confirm the project
n_e4465b52431cc920.source: export default function validate({body,statusCode,bodyEncoding,expected,kind}){if(statusCode!==200||bodyEncoding||!body||typeof body!=='object')throw Error('GitLab '+kind+' is unavailable');if(kind==='branch'&&body.name!==expected)throw Error('GitLab branch mismatch');if(kind==='project'&&!(typeof body.id==='number'||typeof body.id==='string'))throw Error('Invalid GitLab project');return{ok:true}}

n_12ef047390ae4df7.name: Confirm the branch
n_12ef047390ae4df7.source: export default function validate({body,statusCode,bodyEncoding,expected,kind}){if(statusCode!==200||bodyEncoding||!body||typeof body!=='object')throw Error('GitLab '+kind+' is unavailable');if(kind==='branch'&&body.name!==expected)throw Error('GitLab branch mismatch');if(kind==='project'&&!(typeof body.id==='number'||typeof body.id==='string'))throw Error('Invalid GitLab project');return{ok:true}}

n_1a09396202d86fb7.name: Read tagged workflows
n_1a09396202d86fb7.source: export default async function pages({tag,previous},context){const s=previous??{items:[],cursor:null,seen:[]};const r=await context.actions.call('n8n.list_workflows',{tags:tag.split(',').map(x=>x.trim()),limit:100,...(s.cursor?{cursor:s.cursor}:{})});if(!Array.isArray(r?.data))throw Error('Invalid workflow page');const c=r.nextCursor;if(c!==null&&(typeof c!=='string'||!c||s.seen.includes(c)))throw Error('Invalid or repeated cursor');return{state:{items:s.items.concat(r.data),cursor:c,seen:c?[...s.seen,c]:s.seen},more:c!==null}}

n_447b98e9c41c042a.name: Check backup filenames
n_447b98e9c41c042a.source: export default function plan({state,path,projectEndpoint}){if(!Array.isArray(state.items))throw Error('Invalid workflows');const seen=new Set(),items=[];for(const w of state.items){if(!w||typeof w.name!=='string'||!w.name.trim()||typeof w.id!=='string'||!w.id)throw Error('Invalid workflow');const n=w.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,'')+'.json';if(n==='.json'||seen.has(n))throw Error('Workflow filenames collide or are empty');seen.add(n);const filePath=path+'/'+n;items.push({workflow:w,filePath,endpoint:projectEndpoint+'/repository/files/'+encodeURIComponent(filePath),content:JSON.stringify(w,null,4)})}return{items}}

n_4da77a3c385857c8.name: Prepare the next workflow
n_4da77a3c385857c8.source: export default function next({items,previous}){const i=previous?.index??0;if(!Array.isArray(items))throw Error('Invalid backup plan');return i<items.length?{state:{index:i+1},more:true,item:items[i],endpoint:items[i].endpoint+'?ref=main'}:{state:{index:i},more:false,item:{},endpoint:'/unused'}}

n_e4d9e7e5c5f2b540.name: Compare the backup
n_e4d9e7e5c5f2b540.source: import {Buffer} from 'node:buffer';export default function compare({body,statusCode,bodyEncoding,item}){if(bodyEncoding||!item||typeof item.content!=='string')throw Error('Invalid GitLab response');let exists=false,changed=true,lastCommit=null;if(statusCode===200){if(!body||body.file_path!==item.filePath||body.encoding!=='base64'||typeof body.content!=='string'||typeof body.last_commit_id!=='string'||!body.last_commit_id)throw Error('Invalid GitLab file');const b=Buffer.from(body.content.replace(/\s/g,''),'base64');if(!b.length||b.toString('base64').replace(/=+$/,'')!==body.content.replace(/\s|=+$/g,''))throw Error('Invalid GitLab file content');exists=true;changed=b.toString('utf8')!==item.content;lastCommit=body.last_commit_id}else if(statusCode!==404)throw Error('GitLab file lookup failed');const common={branch:'main',content:item.content,commit_message:'Back up n8n workflow'};return{exists,changed,endpoint:item.endpoint,createBody:common,updateBody:{...common,last_commit_id:lastCommit??''}}}

n_3ac9a5192b822f86.name: Confirm the new backup
n_3ac9a5192b822f86.source: export default function confirm({body,statusCode,bodyEncoding,item}){if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||bodyEncoding||body?.file_path!==item.filePath||body?.branch!=='main')throw Error('GitLab write not confirmed');return{ok:true}}

n_716e2124767f3c03.name: Confirm the updated backup
n_716e2124767f3c03.source: export default function confirm({body,statusCode,bodyEncoding,item}){if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||bodyEncoding||body?.file_path!==item.filePath||body?.branch!=='main')throw Error('GitLab write not confirmed');return{ok:true}}
